question: Rohtang pass is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Himachal Pradesh__.**

• **Rohtang Pass** is a high mountain pass on the eastern end of the Pir Panjal Range of the Himalayas around 51 km from Manali in the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh
